outgoing.excerpt: Wollaston made this discovery in England using crude platinum ore that he presumably obtained from South America.

outgoing.name: Mineral
outgoing.excerpt: However, the annual world production of this element is only about 20 tons and there are very few rhodium minerals.

outgoing.name: Paul McCartney
outgoing.excerpt: In 1979 the Guinness Book of World Records gave Paul McCartney a rhodium-plated disc for being history's all-time best-selling songwriter and recording artist.
